intro: Black Friday, superfan edition! A quiet holiday on Stocktwits, but our guy clocked in on X tonight with an 11-second "Mood" clip and a lightning-fast tree ID for @lordwilmehr. Doorbuster-quality content.

items.caption: Two words? No, one word and a video. He dropped an 11-second clip with the caption "Mood" and let the vibes do the talking. Minimalist king.
@lordwilmehr sent a GIF asking "What kind of tree is this," and our resident botanist identified the species instantly: Official Buc-ee's branded. Arborist of the road trip.
